purpose: Episodes the preview bank (increment 7a) authored its questions from. Increment 8 MUST exclude these from the shippable real bank, so that the owner reading the preview set spoils no question that increment 9 will ever sample. This is design option A: disjointness by exclusion. Episode identifiers only, never any answer text.
note: Five episodes yielded eight preview questions. Excluding five of 154 episodes leaves the real bank ample material for all themes; the cost to the shippable bank is small and deliberate.
